scope: Remaining SDK source/notice correspondence gaps only; original release gaps remain separate and must not be removed by this supplement.

gaps.finding: Actual archive matches Arduino 2.0.17, and installed esp_diagnostics.h Apache declaration matches that same official tree; DWARF paths identify esp-rainmaker/components/esp-insights/components/esp_diagnostics. Exact external esp-insights commit and its complete repository-level notice set are not established.
gaps.not_claimed: The IDF 4.4.7 base or its root license is not used to invent an external component source revision.

gaps.finding: Official SDK update commit names exact IDF base 38eeba213a and all 56 selected archives match Arduino 2.0.17. Actual ELF retains v4.4.7-dirty. This proves the distributed archive identity and base reference, not the absence or full set of source/build patches.
gaps.not_claimed: No assertion of reproducible rebuilding of the precompiled SDK from an unmodified IDF tag.

gaps.finding: Component original license files and selected source attributions are added, including the observed fastpbkdf2 CC0 and DES LibTomCrypt notices. Per-file notices for every selected SDK object have not been exhaustively enumerated; 33 archives currently receive only the existing IDF root-text reference in coverage.json. Root terms are not assigned wholesale to all embedded third-party code.
gaps.not_claimed: No complete binary-component notice/SBOM claim. This bounded closure stops at the identified components.

gaps.finding: Archive selection comes from the opening section of a specific candidate map, before --gc-sections. Some selected sections may be removed; subsequent source/relink changes require final map/ELF hash correspondence to be rechecked. No final section-level inventory is supplied.
gaps.not_claimed: Selected archive count is not the count of components proved retained in a future release binary.
